method.standard_deviation: Sample standard deviation (n-1), only when at least two numeric baseline values exist.
method.percentage_difference: absolute difference divided by absolute baseline mean, multiplied by 100; blank when baseline mean is zero.

limitations: OSD-575 represents four Inspiration4 subjects and is exploratory research data.
Comparisons are descriptive and are not clinical validation, diagnosis, prediction or generalisable astronaut-health accuracy.
No interpolation, imputation, cross-panel unit conversion or emergency decision logic is applied.
